schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ad_delivery_tiers" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "name" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "priority" INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  "pricing_model" TEXT,
  "description" TEXT DEFAULT ''
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ad_delivery_tier_collections" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ad_formats" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "name" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "width" INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  "height" INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  "format_type" TEXT,
  "description" TEXT DEFAULT ''
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ad_groups" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "contract_id" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "tier_id" TEXT,
  "name" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "vertical_slug" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "targeting" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "zone_ids" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "start_date" TIMESTAMP DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "end_date" TIMESTAMP DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "daily_budget" REAL DEFAULT 0,
  "total_budget" REAL DEFAULT 0,
  "status" TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ad_variations" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "group_id" TEXT,
  "format_id" TEXT,
  "asset_id" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "name" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "click_url" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "alt_text" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "weight" INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
  "status" TEXT,
  "impressions" INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  "clicks" INTEGER DEFAULT 0
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ad_events" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "variation_id" TEXT,
  "zone_id" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "site_id" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "event_type" TEXT,
  "timestamp" TIMESTAMP,
  "metadata" TEXT DEFAULT ''
);
